name: Olmstead 2005 ascending - audio approximation
description: Auditory-only approximation of Olmstead (2005), Apparatus, journal p. 53: a 35-minute excitatory AVS session beginning at 14 Hz and increasing every 5 minutes to 40 Hz. Because the intermediate frequencies were not reported, this profile uses one continuous 14-to-40-Hz ramp instead of inventing step values. The app omits the white-light glasses and optional Disney story soundtrack; auditory carrier was unspecified, so both ears use a neutral 220 Hz. Not a treatment recommendation.
